interpretation: One complete 360-degree phase cycle corresponds to one nominal arc-bubble length; the 360 divisions are internal phase increments.

nominal.label: user-defined nominal cycle length, not precise Planck-length sixth

calibrated.normalization: choose calibrated value for exact closure to reference Planck length

phaseVsGeometry.distinction: 360 degrees is a single bubble's internal phase cycle; 60 degrees is the optional external six-position drawing's slot angle. They are not the same angle.

planckTime.durationStatus: unassigned; a spatial cycle parameter does not by itself define elapsed time

boundaries: The nominal 2.697e-36 m differs from the Planck-length/6 calibration by about 0.12034%; it is not an exact rounding of that value to the same significant figures.
The 360-degree phase rule parameterizes symbolic arc length, not a measured physical 360-degree trajectory or cycle period.
Six exact calibrated arc bubbles equal one Planck length; six nominal arc bubbles do not equal the CODATA value exactly.
Planck time remains independent; no rotation speed or seconds per cycle has been supplied.
Prior v7.9 and physical constants registers remain unchanged.
